description: A device protection plan picker with device chips, payment options, an optional theft add-on, and a live total.
overview: A protection plan picker: choose a device, pick a payment option for it and, for some devices, add theft and loss cover, with a live total and an Add to Bag button. A photo of the selected device sits beside the options on desktop and above them on mobile. Use it for warranties, insurance add-ons or any per-product plan.
usage: Edit `devices`; each has a name, photo, alt text and payment options with a label, price and optional theft surcharge. The theft switch only appears for Phone Pro, so change that check if other devices offer it. Give Add to Bag a handler.
notes: The total is announced when it changes. Photos are Unsplash placeholders.
